dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Ugh... Fox? Doesn't seem formidable to me...

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: An adventurer should have high expectations. Let's say, dragons, top of all elemental creatures!

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: ...Of course, you can set a bigger goal. But better address the actual problem first.

dialogues.speaker: Baharak
dialogues.text: Anyways, my first little goal is... not to get lost outside Aaru Village just yet. The young lady in the village is quite kind, but it'd be embarrassing to trouble her all the time...
